evidence.reason: Plan argument changed from "monthly" to "benchmark"; the test only asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0, so a wrong plan string would not be caught.
Default multiplier changed from configuration.rate to 0, silently changing the default charge for callers that omit the multiplier.
chargeUnit is value-referenced by subscriptionCharge and backward-referenced by usageCharge, coupling the two edited symbols through the metering pipeline.
Test asserts only positivity (subscriptionCharge(40) > 0) and does not pin the plan string or multiplier default, so the joint behavior change is not covered.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动通过 chargeUnit 与计量管线耦合，且测试只校验结果为正，无法确认 "benchmark" 计划与默认 multiplier=0 的合并行为是否符合预期。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge 的维护者确认 "benchmark" 是否为合法计划名，并请 src/metering.ts#usageCharge 的维护者确认默认 multiplier 改为 0 是否有意；若不确定，应恢复为 configuration.rate 或补充覆盖该默认值的测试。
